viewing_check: Estimate $20-40 for three framed prints, current bid $10 (hammer, plus 22% premium). Typical single Vanity Fair prints sell A$26-47, a framed lot of 4 sold A$128, so three framed could return about A$90-130 gross. Sports subjects (cricket, billiards) sell A$67-321, so check the captions on the three prints in person: if any sitter is a cricketer, jockey or other sportsman, the value jumps. Check whether original (paper, caption, no dot printing, Vanity Fair imprint) or later reproduction. Prices fairly steady 2024-2026.
